chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the blood money for intentional killing, and he said: "One hundred of the mature male camels. If there are no camels, then in place of each camel there are twenty male sheep."

key_terms.الْإِبِلِ: camels used here as the principal measure of compensation
key_terms.الْغَنَمِ: sheep used here as an alternative compensatory livestock
key_terms.دِيَةِ: blood money or legal compensation due for homicide

ai.seo_question: What is the diyyah for intentional killing according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the diyyah for intentional killing. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that it is one hundred mature male camels, and if camels are unavailable, each camel is substituted by twenty male sheep.
